# Black Lab Deals

Black Lab Deals is a shopping and affiliate deal-discovery site focused on current deals found on Amazon. The site organizes active price drops, coupons, best-seller deals, category deals, and budget-friendly offers so shoppers can compare current Amazon offers more quickly.

## Primary URLs

- https://blacklabdeals.com/ - Main live Amazon deals feed.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/top-100-amazon-deals-today/ - Top 100 deals found on Amazon today.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/best-amazon-deals-under-50/ - Deals under $50.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/best-amazon-tool-deals/ - Tool and home improvement deals.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/best-amazon-home-kitchen-deals/ - Home and kitchen deals.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/best-amazon-electronics-deals/ - Electronics deals.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/categories/ - Category hub.
- https://blacklabdeals.com/search.html - Search current Black Lab Deals pages.

## Important Disclosures

Black Lab Deals participates in the Amazon Associates affiliate program and may earn from qualifying purchases. Prices and availability can change at any time. Final price and availability are shown on Amazon at checkout. Amazon and the Amazon logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. Black Lab Deals is independent and is not endorsed by Amazon.

## Crawling

The site allows OAI-SearchBot, OAI-AdsBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, and standard search crawlers in robots.txt. The XML sitemap is available at https://blacklabdeals.com/sitemap.xml.
